jei.flavor_immersed_daily.woodbasin_info: How to use: right-click the basin with “Purified Water” to fill it (a dry basin processes nothing), then right-click it with the item to wash (silkworm cocoon, chicken, etc.); after a moment take out the result and extra drops
jei.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.basin_sil: Reeling silk needs a water-filled wooden basin: right-click the basin with Purified Water first.
Then right-click that filled basin with Silkworm Cocoons — the whole stack is reeled at once, no waiting one by one.
Each cocoon yields one Silk and one Raw Silkworm Chrysalis, and the water in the basin is used up, so refill it next time.
jei.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.harvester: §7§oPlaces a Harvester. Right-click to ride and drive — it automatically harvests mature crops in a 7×7 area, replants seeds, and collects drops into its own inventory. Sneak + right-click to open the inventory.
jei.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.river_sil: Lay River Silt on the riverbed (water must be above it) and right-click it with Aquatic Feed to turn it wet.
Then right-click with a sea cucumber, clam, oyster, scallop, river snail, crayfish, spoon worm, sea urchin, razor clam, mantis shrimp, jellyfish, Akiami shrimp or abalone to plant it and let it grow.
When mature it yields three; right-click to harvest, and the silt dries out - feed it again to start the next round.

patchouli.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.dev: This volume is written for modpack authors and server owners: every config option, every data-pack JSON you can customise, the code behind each mechanic, and step-by-step tutorials for changing them. Back up your world and data folder before you begin.
patchouli.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.gui: East of the fence, south of the mountain — where the plough turns the soil and the rod rests over the water. This scroll gathers three chapters: Farming, Livestock, and Fishing. Open the table of contents and pick one to begin.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.activ: §7§oRight-click on water to apply: adsorbs impurities to lower turbidity and balances conductivity.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.atm: §7§oPlace it down and right-click with a §fBank Card§7 to open that card's account screen: deposit the notes in its slots into the balance, withdraw them back by denomination, and change the card holder.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.cardb: §7§oA honeycomb imitation made of cardboard, a material for insect breeding.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.cater: §7§oHang it on a wall. Right-click empty-handed to open or close for business. When open it calls over up to §f6 customers§7, who will find marked seats and place orders — hand them the right food to collect the reward.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.credi: §7§oRight-click to open its §f9 slots§7 for storing banknotes; take it to a §fSelf-Service ATM§7 to move money in or out of the balance.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.dead_: §7§oFinish the animal off with the §fBone Cutter Knife§7 to get its carcass. Hang it on the §fBig Hook§7, then carve it up stage by stage with the required knives.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.dosin: §7§oA fitting in the water pipe network: right-click with §fJinkela§7 to load one, and for §f5 minutes§7 every sprinkler in the network waters crops with a little random fertilizing.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.feed_: §7§oRight-click to use: every fish, squid, crab, shrimp and turtle within §f30 blocks§7 is set to spawn - after 5 minutes each drops one of its kind. Babies simply grow up a step.
§7Those already spawning or pregnant will not eat, so one item only feeds the ones that need it.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.feedi: §7§oOne slot for feed (§fwheat§7, §fcarrot§7 or this mod's feeds) or §fTidy Water§7. Hungry or thirsty animals nearby will walk over and help themselves.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.fire_: §7§oRight-click to spray foam and put out fires around you; extinguishing a station's forest fire earns score. Costs §f1§7 durability each use.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.fish_: §7§oA bottomless glass fish tank. Set it in water to hold that block of water; neighbouring tanks join up on their own — tile them sideways or stack them up.

§7§oA board to show off your catch. Right-click with any fish in hand to hang it up — the live model is drawn on the board; right-click with an empty hand to take it back. Point at it to see how much it weighs.

§7§oDrop it in water and it becomes a catching net: every so often an aquatic creature spawns right above it — saltwater fare in ocean biomes, freshwater elsewhere (§fother mods' fish included§7). Players can walk right through; animals cannot.
§7§oA net cage set in the water. Live fish caught nearby swim right into the cage; fish carried in the §fFishing Net§7 can be emptied in by right-clicking. Breaking the cage sets them free.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.fishi: §7§oCatches without a living form (shrimp, crabs and the like) go into this box's §f36§7 slots; right-click with an empty hand to open it.
§7§oHold right-click on water to inflate it into a §f5×5§7 platform that any creature can stand on. Hit it a few times to take it back.

§7§oHold it in either hand and right-click a fish to scoop it into the net (up to §f3§7). A caught fish goes into a nearby §fFish Keeper§7 first and only flies over when there is none. Right-click a §fFish Keeper§7 to empty the net in, or right-click a block to release the fish.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.flea_: §7§oRight-click an animal to use one: cleanliness goes straight to full and the §fFly Bite§7 debuff is washed off.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.handc: §7§oPlace it down and right-click to hitch it behind you; it follows closely. Sneak to let go.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.harro: §7§oRight-click to till a §f3×3§7 patch of ground into farmland at once — it reaches ground a block higher or lower too, and clears away the grass and weeds on top. Costs §f1§7 durability.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.harve: §7§oPlace and ride to harvest nearby crops and collect drops. (Has its own inventory)
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.herbi: §7§oRight-click to spray and clear the weeds around you; if the station in range suffers a weed outbreak, it is resolved and earns score.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.high_: §7§oA high-protein compound made from any insect roe or adult. Drop it into the septic tank to ferment it into §aOrganic Fertilizer§7.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.insec: §7§oA light board, a material for insect breeding.
§7§oRight-click with an empty hand to open the interface. Four zones — feed, parents, carrier and offspring — where insects are raised much like crops.
§7§oA net for catching insects. Sweep it through grass to catch cicadas, locusts, silkworms or bees.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.lives: §7§oRight-click any farm animal to brush it, slowly raising its §fmood§7 and §fcleanliness§7. It can only take one brushing every 20 seconds.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.marsh: §7§oBurns like fuel (§f8 items§7), or right-click to throw — it blows up, hurting mobs but never blocks.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.metha: §7§oStacks on top of the septic tank. Every time the tank ferments, a unit of §fPressurized Marsh Gas§7 is stored inside. Right-click to take some out.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.micro: §7§oRight-click on water to apply: microbes break down organic pollution and lower the organic index.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.milke: §7§oRight-click an adult animal to milk it: cows give milk, goats give fresh goat milk, camels give camel milk, and untamed wolves give wild dog milk (the wolf is angered afterwards). §f2~5§7 bottles each time, costing §f1§7 mood.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.nav_p: §7§oSneak + right-click to flip it open or shut; once open, right-click to browse takeout orders.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.organ: §7§oFermented out of feces. Acts exactly like §fbonemeal§7.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.oxyph: §7§oRight-click on water to apply: neutralises acidity and raises pH.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.pet_n: §7§oTamed cats and dogs nearby will walk over and settle here — one pet per nest. Should they pass away, they come back on it the next day.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.poiso: §7§oRight-click a §fScarecrow§7 to set it up at its feet (the scarecrow stays). No mouse can spawn within §f16 blocks§7, and the station itself never breaks.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.poop: §7§oRight-click to pick up. Edible — fills you a little but leaves you queasy; sneak + right-click to throw it at someone.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.poult: §7§oRight-click any animal (young or adult) to stuff it into the sack; right-click again to let it out.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.proto: §7§oRight-click on water to apply: neutralises alkalinity and lowers pH.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.purch: §7§oRight-click empty-handed to open a §f27-slot§7 box. Tip your economic produce in and press §fSell§7 to turn the lot into banknotes at today's buy price (per stack of 64); the notes drop straight back into the box's free slots, largest denominations first.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.range: §7§oRight-click a log of a tree to mark a forestry station — one per chunk, and the chunk needs at least §f5§7 trees. Sneak + right-click to remove it. Right-click the air to open the station screen with every coordinate, score and status.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.rangi: §7§oHold it to see the border of the chunk you are standing in, handy for sizing up a station.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_a: §7§oThe abalone ranks first among the "eight treasures of the sea", with firm, springy meat long regarded as a banquet delicacy.
§7§oThe akiami shrimp is named for the fine hairs on its body. Tiny in size, it is the main ingredient of dried shrimp and shrimp paste.
§7§oThe anglerfish is named for the glowing lure on its head. A deep-sea ambush predator, its liver is prized as the "foie gras of the sea".
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_b: §7§oCalifornia bass (or largemouth bass) is a bass species native to the U.S. state of California, and it is also a familiar sight in wet markets across China.
§7§oThe bighead carp, also known as the "king of the four great carp," is the largest of the four major carp species in China. It is renowned for its meaty flesh and is often used in Chinese cuisine.
§7§oThe black carp, also known as the "king of the four great carp," is the largest of the four major carp species in China. It is renowned for its meaty flesh and is often used in Chinese cuisine.
§7§oNorthern snakehead, also known as the black fish, is highly nutritious and has a smooth, slippery body.
§7§oThe brown crab, also known as the edible crab, is named for its round, plump shell that resembles a loaf of bread. Rich in crab roe, it is a common edible crab in Europe.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_c: §7§oIn some Chinese regions, this specifically refers to the clarias catfish (walking catfish), but in general usage, it's a common nickname for catfish.
§7§oCarp is one of the four major freshwater fish species in China.
§7§oChinese mackerel, also known as blue mackerel, is a very common economic fish along the Pacific coast.
§7§oIts other names are flower clam and flower shell, and it is actually one of the four major traditional aquaculture mollusks in China, with extremely high economic value.

§7§oThe crayfish — native to North America, now one of the top-selling late-night seafood snacks in China with an annual production of over 30 million tons — is a notorious invasive species that has been fished so hard it now depends on artificial breeding to keep its population up.
§7§oCrucian carp, which grows in freshwater rivers, has many fine bones throughout its body and is well suited for making soup.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_e: §7§oThe eel is a catadromous fish: it grows up in freshwater and, once mature, swims to the deep sea to spawn. Its rich, fatty flesh works equally well in Japanese kabayaki or Chinese braised dishes.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_g: §7§oThe goby, commonly known as the "climbing tiger," is a small bottom-dwelling fish that gives anglers headaches while making gourmands' mouths water.
§7§oGrass carp, also known as white amur, is one of the four major Chinese carps.
§7§oThe tiger grouper is a kind of grouper named for the tiger-like markings on its body, with tender and delicious flesh.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_h: §7§oRibbonfish live in the deep sea and swim to shallow waters at night to feed. They die immediately upon being brought to the surface due to the drastic pressure change, which makes them difficult to farm artificially, so they are almost entirely caught by wild fishing.
§7§oAlso known as the hairy crab, it is famous for its two hair-covered claws and its plump, rich crab roe and crab paste in mid-autumn. It is the most iconic freshwater edible crab in China.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_j: §7§oThe Japanese halfbeak has a needle-like extended lower jaw. It is a common small coastal food fish, often dried into snacks.
§7§oOnce pickled, the jellyfish becomes the crisp "jellyfish skin" and "jellyfish head" served as a cold dish.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_k: §7§oThe Alaska king crab is not a true crab but a distant relative of hermit crabs. Its long, meaty legs are a costly delicacy on the dining table.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_l: §7§oLoach is a type of freshwater fish found in rivers and streams in China. They are often kept as pets and are also eaten in Chinese cuisine.
§7§oThe American lobster, commonly known as the Boston lobster, has a pair of unequally sized claws. Its firm, springy meat makes it a luxurious seafood in Western cuisine.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_m: §7§oMandarin fish, also known as the peach blossom fish, has tender and delicate flesh and has been praised in verse since ancient times.
§7§oThe mantis shrimp is fierce and aggressive, yet its meat is sweet and springy. It is also called the "pissing shrimp".
§7§oAlthough it belongs to the crab family, it is so common in its producing regions that it rivals rice and wheat — not a festival-only treat, but an everyday delicacy of daily life.
§7§oThe mud shrimp is not a shrimp, but a collective name for a mixture of marine plankton. It is fairly common in the waters off Fujian, China, and is extremely demanding about water quality.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_o: §7§oThe Rushan oyster, known as the "milk of the sea", is plump and juicy, best eaten raw or charcoal-grilled.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_p: §7§oThe Pacific saury is named for its slender, knife-like body and its peak season in autumn. A common coastal food fish, it grills up rich and fragrant.
§7§oThe pleco, also known as the "armoured catfish" or "cleaner fish," is a freshwater fish native to South America, now a notorious invasive species in China.

§7§oAlso known as the Eastern prawn or jumbo shrimp, it is the most important economic shrimp species in northern China. It is large in size, thin-shelled, and meaty. It is named after the historical practice of counting them in pairs.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_r: §7§oThe razor clam has a long, bamboo-like shell and tender flesh, commonly found on tidal flats.
§7§oThe longsnout catfish, which originated in the Yangtze River basin of China, is also known as the "river tuft."
§7§oThe redfin, also known as the "beardfish," is a freshwater fish native to China. It is prized for its meat and is often used in Chinese cuisine. It is also known for its distinctive red fins.
§7§oIt can be seen along the banks of rivers and lakes, in ponds and water fields from south to north.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_s: §7§oThe sardine, also known as the Japanese sillago, is a small schooling pelagic fish often canned or dried.
§7§oThe Weihai scallop has a fan-shaped shell; its dried adductor muscle is the prized "dried scallop".
§7§oThe sea cucumber is a prized sea delicacy, long honored as the "ginseng of the sea".
§7§oThe sea snail has a thick shell and firm flesh, and is a common seafood on coastal tables.
§7§oThe sea urchin's orange-yellow gonads, known as "uni", are regarded as a delicacy of the sea.
§7§oSilver carp is a very common type of carp/pomfret.
§7§oSilver pomfret, also known as silvery pomfret, is a very common economic fish along the Pacific coast.
§7§oThe spoon worm, commonly known as the sea intestine, is named for its unusual shape and is a specialty seafood of the Jiaodong region.
§7§oSquid are soft-bodied cephalopods with eight arms and two long tentacles. Put the whole squid on a chopping board and cut it up for meat and tentacles.
§7§oThe thickest cut of the squid, easy to score and quick to stir-fry.
§7§oThe arms and tentacles of the squid, crisp and springy — best blanched and served cold.
§7§oThe swimming crab is very common along the Chinese coast and has extremely high economic value. It is the most widely distributed and abundant marine crab species in Chinese waters.

§7§oThe swordfish, also known as the broadbill, has a long, sword-like snout and is one of the fastest fish in the ocean. Its flesh is firm and almost boneless, making it a favorite for steaks and grilling.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.raw_t: §7§oTench, also called the doctor fish, is prized for its fine, tender meat.
§7§oTilapia, native to Africa, is commonly known as Nile perch.

§7§oTuna are warm-blooded, oceanic fish that swim continuously at high speed their entire lives to maintain respiration. Prized for their delicious meat and heavily fished, wild tuna stocks face significant pressure.

§7§oCommonly known as the soft-shelled turtle, it is the most widely distributed and common freshwater turtle in China. Its tender meat and thick calipash make it a prized nourishing delicacy on the table.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.recei: §7§oRight-click empty-handed to see today's menu: §f40 foods§7 drawn from every mod, shown but untakeable. Flip the switch in the top-right corner to take orders — only then does the machine now and then spit out a receipt and call over a §fDelivery Rider§7. Hand him the right food to claim the reward.
§7Add a blacklist under the §fTakeout§7 section in the §fconfig§7 to keep certain foods out.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.river: §7§oLay it on the riverbed, then right-click with §fAquatic Feed§7 to turn it wet. Plant a sea cucumber, clam, oyster, scallop, river snail, crayfish, spoon worm, sea urchin, razor clam, mantis shrimp, jellyfish, Akiami shrimp or abalone; once grown, right-click to harvest three. Right-click with §fAquatic Feed§7 while it grows to speed it up.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.rod_p: §7§oCast the hook first, then set the §fNanshan Fishing Rod§7 on it to keep watch. When a fish bites it alerts the §fnearest player§7, who can right-click to take the rod back and pick up the fight exactly where the hook was; it drops the rod after §f5 minutes§7 unattended.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.rotat: §7§oFits on the end of a water pipe network: once water reaches it, its arm spins and sprays water in a circle. It still works with §fone solid block§7 between it and the pipe.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.salt_: §7§oPlace it by the water: when water touches its top it drinks the water above and turns wet; once dry, a separate §fSalt Pile§7 forms above it and grows from stage 1 to 3 on its own. Breaking the pile only drops salt (§f1 / 2 / 3§7 by stage, with Fortune bonus) - the pan itself is never destroyed.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.scare: §7§oProtects farmland within §f8 blocks§7. Sneak-right-click or hit it §f3§7 times to take it back, right-click to rename; use a §fgenuine player ID§7 as the name to wear their skin.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.seat_: §7§oRight-click a block to mark it as a seat customers can sit on. Right-click again, or break that block, to remove the mark.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.secto: §7§oFits on the end of a water pipe network: once water reaches it, it sprays water in a fan over the ground ahead. It still works with §fone solid block§7 between it and the pipe.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.septi: §7§oTwo blocks wide. Gathers every §ffeces§7 within 8 blocks into the §6left half§7; stored feces slowly ferment into §aOrganic Fertilizer§7 in the right half. Right-click the left half to load or take feces (it also takes §fHigh-Protein Compound§7), the right half to take fertilizer.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.sewin: §7§oRight-click with a blank silk piece to load it onto the table, then right-click again to paint patterns and dress it with a real suit of armor.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.shopp: §7§oRight-click empty-handed to open: on the §fShopping§7 tab browse shops, add items to a cart and check out (put a §fBank Card§7 in the card slot to pay); on the §fMy Shop§7 tab create your own shop and list / delist / reprice / restock / withdraw.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.sickl: §7§oRight-click a crop to harvest every mature crop in a §f3×3§7 area and replant it. Benefits from §bFortune§7. Costs §f1§7 durability per crop.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.silk: §7§oHold right-click briefly to spend one and mend a random piece of your armour that has taken damage.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.steel: §7§oRight-click to open the weighing interface: put something on the pan and it is given a weight. Bigger fish weigh more, and a truly huge one is announced server-wide.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.stock: §7§oRight-click a farm animal to crack the whip, driving every animal of that kind within §f12 blocks§7 forward in a herd.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.straw: §7§oWear it on your head. When you harvest a crop, it sometimes grants §bFortune +1§7.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.syrin: §7§oAttack a farm animal to draw its genes into the needle; then attack an animal in §fgood shape§7 (satiety, thirst, cleanliness and mood all §f7§7 or more) to make it pregnant with §f3~5§7 young of that species — eight minutes later they are born right there.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.takea: §7§oDeliver it to the glowing delivery point and right-click to hand it over.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.tree_: §7§oRight-click a tree of a station to wipe out an aphid infestation.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.uav: §7§oPlace it down, then bind a Drone Controller to it. With power on it hovers; it descends slowly when switched off. With a care module that has recorded corners installed, it flies to the centre of that area and keeps working.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.uav_c: §7§oRight-click a drone to bind it, then right-click anywhere to open the control panel: unbind, first-person piloting and power.
§7§oBound to a drone — right-click anywhere to open the control panel.
§7§oNot bound yet — right-click a drone to bind it.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.uav_m: §7§oA drone care module: installed in the module slot, the drone flies to ripe crops and fruiting leaves within the recorded area and harvests them, takes the harvest to the nearest container, and also fills troughs, fertilizes crops and moves eggs into the coop's hatch. Feed, water and bone meal go into the drone's own slots.

§7§oA drone module for piloting: the drone can eat from the use slot, and both mouse buttons fire. Arrows, ammo and throwables are taken from the drone's backpack, and each weapon fires through its own logic.

§7§oA drone harvest module: installed in the module slot, the drone flies to ripe crops and fruiting leaves within the recorded area and harvests them one by one, then carries the harvest to the nearest container in (or just around) that area and drops it if there is none.
§7§oA drone module for piloting: right-click a block to highlight it, right-click it again to clear. The outline shows through blocks and only while you are piloting the drone.

§7§oRight-click two blocks to record two horizontal corners (height does not matter), then put the module into the drone's module slot and it flies there and keeps working. Right-click the air while holding it to wipe the record.
§7§oRight-click one more block to record corner B.

§7§oA drone module for transport: put a §fCardboard Box§7 in the drone's use slot, and it flies to the centre of the auto range, drops the box with everything in the drone packed inside, then returns to where it took off.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.water: §7§oRight-click to measure the station's water level. Normal level is §f60~66§7 m; flood or drought pushes it far off that range.
§7§oRight-click on water (not consumed): balances dissolved oxygen to a suitable level.
§7§oPlace it down and it links up with any adjacent water pipe on its own, whatever the direction or how you build.
§7§oBury it in water and every water pipe linked to it fills up. The open end of a pipe at the very edge of the network splashes water.

§7§oRight-click to measure the station's water quality: dissolved oxygen, pH, organic pollution, conductivity, turbidity and an overall grade. Detected water disasters are logged to the Ranger Clipboard.
§7§oFill it with water, then hold right-click on crops to water and ripen them.

§7§oStanding on a water source, it runs and turns into a §fthree-block-tall water source§7: it irrigates farmland and counts as water for anything else that needs it (§fother mods included§7), and an empty bucket can scoop water straight out of it. A splash and a trickle play whenever there is water below or in its own block.
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.weath: §7§oPlace it in a station chunk. The rotor turns slowly in calm weather, but spins fast once the chunk hits abnormal weather (fire, flood, drought, acid rain).
tooltip.flavor_immersed_daily_argo.whist: §7§oRight-click to blow: nearby wandering pets switch to following, and nearby tamed mounts make their way over to you.
